assessment: Independent source-first whole-bank challenge of benchmark-v8 Q01–Q108
scope: Original Nemesis; basic board; standard semi-cooperative core; six original Characters. English manual and current official FAQ base-game Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items are controlling unless an explicit exception/correction applies. Original PL/FR/DE manuals supplement and expose conflicts, not automatic English replacements.

read_boundary.primary_review: English operative manual text pp6–26 read in full, together with the complete supplied English extraction before optional modes. PDF contact sheets of English pp1–26 inspected; focused full-size/cropped inspection of illustrated rules/cards on pp8,10,13,15,17,19–23,25. PL/FR/DE operative reading text pp6,8–26 read; FR component-thumbnail text p3 checked as repeated Room material. Localized p23 illustrations checked to distinguish glyphs obscured by overlapping English card art; DE p22 Six Shooter checked. Optional modes pp27 and quick-reference p28 were not used.
read_boundary.faq_boundary: Only base-game Rules (excluding cooperative Rules17–18), Actions (excluding Intruder-player Actions16), Rooms and Items used. An initial unbounded extraction display also exposed expansion text after the Items section; none of it was used as evidence, questions, or coverage support.
read_boundary.maps_use: Structural section/ID indexes only; prior pass counts, accepted-ID history and map saturation language are not evidence of completeness.
read_boundary.visual_limit: Thumbnail component art with obscured/unreadable card text is not treated as a complete card corpus. This report does not claim every physical card or every illustration in every localization is independently legible.

method: Compare each actual request and key to the scoped primary procedures; reject a candidate when its material fact is already requested even if a key needs completion. Treat parameter substitutions and combinations of already-covered rules as non-novel. Accept only an unrequested source-supported procedure, restriction, priority or outcome branch.

bounded_coverage_verdict.verdict: The 108-question bank is not saturated within the supplied primary-source scope.
bounded_coverage_verdict.basis: There are unrequested, consequential English-primary procedures in Noise/Doors and illustrated Item/Weapon cards, even after checking all 108 actual requests and keys. A structural section map labeling Items/Combat covered does not entail coverage of those card-specific procedures.
bounded_coverage_verdict.after_additions: Accepting these questions would close the demonstrated gaps; it would not prove absolute rule saturation. Further additions still require the same actual-request comparison and readable primary evidence. No undefined shortage procedure or conflicting localization is silently converted into a ruling.
